content: Geiss AG – one step ahead - Geiss. # History of GEISS AG. The history of GEISS is an impressive success story in the world of thermoforming and CNC technology, starting with its foundation in 1948. Since 1957, we have supplied the manufacturing industry with over 3000 machines in more than 40 countries. Around 2000 of these are still in operation today, which emphasises the outstanding quality and durability of our products. Find out more about the development history of GEISS and discover our commitment to technological progress and customer satisfaction. First fully motorised thermoforming machines. Overview:
We as GEISS AG stand for precision and innovation in plastic processing. Since our founding in 1948, we have led the development of thermoforming systems, CNC machining solutions, and automation technologies. Our product portfolio offers state-of-the-art technology, known for quality and reliability, tailored to meet the needs of various industries. Guided by our motto, “one step ahead,” we continuously advance technological innovation to deliver efficient and future-ready solutions to our clients.
